verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded exposes a broad API covering company onboarding, regular and off-cycle payroll, contractor payments, time-off approve/decline (callable directly instead of using the embedded flow), webhooks, and tax configuration. Partners can build custom experiences purely on these APIs rather than the pre-built UI flows. However, some features appear to route through pre-built flows instead, such as the Guideline 401(k) link. The official CLI explicitly cannot run or submit payroll. No documentation claims full UI-to-API parity. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API-native coverage for flow-only features like 401(k)/benefits setup, an agent-facing path to submit payroll, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
